product.title: Westminster 3 Hour Walking Tour and Visit of Churchill War Rooms

description.text: With such a high concentration of world-famous attractions, Westminster is an essential stop on any London sightseeing itinerary. After a walking tour of the borough’s major attractions, descend into the Churchill War Rooms to learn the secrets of the famous leader as he strategized during World War II. Stops include Westminster Abbey, Big Ben, Buckingham Palace, Churchill War Rooms. This landmark-packed tour is perfect for history buffs looking for a manageable but extensive tour to fit into a busy schedule. Ideal for visitors basing in London who want a guided city experience without coordinating Tube routes, attraction tickets, or landmark timing on their own.
